overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 2-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness experience right in the comfort of your home. Constructed from elegant Canadian Red Cedar, this sauna features six PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels strategically placed for optimal heat distribution, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, it includes a modern interior touch screen control panel and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized, spa-like atmosphere. With its sophisticated design and health benefits, this sauna is a perfect addition to any wellness routine.
